_comment: Accepted high/critical advisories for the app's production dependency tree, read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date; the gate fails on any advisory not listed here and on any entry past its review_by. Accept only advisories with no usable fix -- update the package instead whenever one exists.

accepted.reason: No fixed version (every release through 3.0.3, the latest, is affected). Reached only via metro/@expo/cli file watching and glob matching at build/dev time, on patterns from the repo's own config -- not in the shipped web bundle and never fed untrusted input.

No fixed version (1.4.0 is the latest). Used by @expo/cli's code-signing certificates for development builds; TWAIN ships a static web build and verifies no signatures with it. RETICLE accepts the same advisory for the same reason.

Fixed only in image-size 2.x, but metro 0.84 (via react-native 0.85) requires ^1.0.2 and calls the 1.x API, so the fix can't be forced without breaking the bundler. Metro reads the dimensions of the repo's own image assets at build time; no untrusted images are parsed and it is not in the web bundle. Drop this entry when metro moves to image-size 2.
Same as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: fixed only in 2.x, which metro's ^1.0.2 range excludes; build-time parsing of repo-controlled assets only.
